newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's Dong Won Fisheries starts trading Friday.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's Dong Won Fisheries starts trading Friday.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Won Fisheries Co Ltd's initial public offering (IPO) will begin trading on Friday, along with three other offerings, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
Dong Won will list 600,000 new shares. The shares had a subscription price of 11,000 won each and were offered during October 7-8.
The following shares will join Dong Won on Friday:
Wooshin Industries Co Ltd, a PVC producer, will list 260,000 shares. The IPO price was set at 20,000 won per share.
Mirae Corp, a maker of semiconductor inspection equipment, will list 380,000 shares. The subscription price was 40,000 won per share.
Kohap Petrochemical Corp, a chemical products producer, will list 3.86 million shares. The subscription price was 10,500 won per share.
The exchange said these shares will trade only in the morning session, 9:30-11:30 a.m. (0030-0230 GMT) on Friday.
This was to ensure that the exchange computer was not overwhelmed with orders, the exchange said.
On the first day of LG Semicon's listing on November 9, the exchange had to halt trading in the shares because the computer system was paralysed by a deluge of sell orders.
